feature: Dual-stack peer connectivity inspired by go2rtc

implementation.native_discovery: Linux, macOS and Windows advertise eligible IPv4 and IPv6 underlay addresses. Deduplicate and reserve room for both families within the existing 16-interface cap. IPv4 remains first for management-source preference; Linux tracks IPv6 kernel address/route events and rejects tentative, DAD-failed and deprecated addresses.
implementation.direct_peers: Carry existing private IP packets through ICE and pinned DTLS over either UDP address family. One unavailable bind does not discard other working interfaces. IPv4-only peers remain compatible.
implementation.stun: Resolve at most two STUN servers independently, try up to four family-compatible addresses per server on one receive owner, correlate source and random transaction IDs, and retain the 1.5-second total budget. No periodic discovery traffic is added.
implementation.underlay_tcp: Race IPv4 and IPv6 for new relay/proxy TCP connections, with at most two concurrent attempts. Bind explicitly advertised sources, retain one-second attempt bounds, drop the losing socket and do not fall back to an unbound source.
implementation.scope: Adopts address gathering and connection racing techniques in Rust without embedding go2rtc, adding dependencies or changing the wire protocol. This does not add an ICE-TCP peer data carrier, WebRTC browser DataChannels, media transcoding or private IPv6 exit routing.

reliability.existing_transfers: Candidate/interface updates retain existing healthy peer sessions and flow pinning. Only the one-time agent binary update reconnects services.
reliability.privacy: No router, firewall, host DNS or exit-policy exceptions are installed. Existing IPv6 leak protection on IPv4-only exits remains enforced; blocked IPv6 paths fall back to available existing transports.
reliability.fallback: Existing authenticated relay and IPv4 routes retained. No claim of universal NAT traversal or unchanged throughput on every network.

verification.mesh: 37 tests passed, including real IPv6 full-size packet transfers, IPv4-blackhole simulation, IPv4-only peer interoperability, unreachable first STUN server, IPv6 STUN, source/transaction validation, relay cancellation, certificate rejection and active stream carrier-change regressions.
verification.agent_network: 78 agent regressions and 19 network tests passed on release 1.8.9. All ten native platform jobs and complete bundle validation passed in Actions 41190892302 (runtime source 9eb669af297e35fc8fa2a54f6723c4edf9894364).
verification.signaling_e2e: Four isolated API+Mongo controller tests passed: direct IPv4 and IPv6 transfers after the entire gateway stops, underlay replacement without interrupting healthy sessions, and relay authentication/source/lease enforcement. Fixed a pre-existing fixture that dropped its relay configuration sender before transfer. Disposable test database removed.
verification.minimum_mtu: Full-size encrypted IPv6 packet transfer passed with loopback MTU 1280 in an owned disposable Docker network namespace. No host networking configuration changed; container removed.
